settings.title: Settings
help.1: Deal and reveal real cards as usual. FeltCircle only replaces the chips.
help.2: Blinds are posted automatically and the player to act is highlighted.
help.3: Use the slider to choose a bet or raise, then confirm. Nothing is bet while dragging.
help.4: When a betting round ends, the host confirms that the next cards were dealt.
help.5: At showdown the host selects the winner of each pot. Side pots are calculated automatically.
help.6: Export Chips gives a short text with every seat's balance, so you can continue later in any mode.
help.7: At showdown, tap “I Won!” or “I Lost / Muck”. The host confirms the winner of each pot.

hands.title: Hand Rankings
hands.intro: Strongest to weakest. Your hand is the best five cards from your two hole cards and the five community cards.
hands.royalFlush.name: Royal Flush
hands.royalFlush.desc: A, K, Q, J and 10, all of the same suit.
hands.straightFlush.name: Straight Flush
hands.straightFlush.desc: Five cards in sequence, all of the same suit.
hands.fourKind.name: Four of a Kind
hands.fourKind.desc: Four cards of the same rank.
hands.fullHouse.name: Full House
hands.fullHouse.desc: Three of a kind plus a pair.
hands.flush.name: Flush
hands.flush.desc: Any five cards of the same suit, not in sequence.
hands.straight.name: Straight
hands.straight.desc: Five cards in sequence, of mixed suits.
hands.threeKind.name: Three of a Kind
hands.threeKind.desc: Three cards of the same rank.
hands.twoPair.name: Two Pair
hands.pair.name: One Pair
hands.pair.desc: Two cards of the same rank.
hands.highCard.name: High Card
hands.highCard.desc: None of the above: the highest card plays.
hands.rule.best5: Use any five of the seven available cards (your two plus the five on the board), even all five from the board.
hands.rule.kickers: Within the same category the higher ranks win; the remaining cards (kickers) break further ties.
hands.rule.ties: When the best five cards have the same ranks, the hands tie.
hands.rule.split: Tied hands split the pot equally; an odd chip goes to the first winner clockwise from the dealer.
hands.rule.aceStraight: An ace can be high (10-J-Q-K-A) or low (A-2-3-4-5, the lowest straight), but straights do not wrap around (Q-K-A-2-3).
hands.rule.flush: Flushes are compared by their highest card, then the next highest, and so on.
hands.rule.suits: Suits have no ranking: ♠ ♥ ♦ ♣ are all equal.
hands.note: FeltCircle never reads cards: compare your real cards at the table, then confirm the winner.
